build: Modwerk's linker: the Modwerk base's send-bus variant f824d778 (repeat98/modwerk#1447) + this folder's BD ANALOG 0.2.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version BA20
conditions: CARD: dtboot ba20.syx --every 999G --card card.img --instr 9G --card-save --press YES@3900M:12M --press NO@6001M:12M --press NO@6503M:12M (formats the card, clears the notices). Then the plans below on that card: the four NO presses clear the calibration notices, FUNC + SRC opens BD's machine list on BD HARD, four DOWN presses reach BD ANALOG, YES chooses it, PUSH_B taps encoder B. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.
